description: WP-O6 Codex: Orks (11e) AMMO RUNTS (Boyz, once per battle per unit) through the real unit_selected_to_shoot window. Fixture ork11e_ab_shoot: the Warboss leads Boyz C. A real click on the Boyz opens the window; a real click on the 0-CP 'Ammo Runts' card ('Use on Boyz') flags the Boyz; the window re-opens with BOSS' AMMO RUNT still on offer and a second click uses it too (both apply to this selection). The Boyz' shootas then fire at Witchseekers C (dispatched): the hit rolls carry +1 with an 'Ammo Runts' ledger entry. Setup privileges: auto wound allocation, the Custodes' wounds inflated so every target survives the shot.
